objective: Audit the app in Argent on the emulator, improve UI/UX polish, consistency and shared implementation, and verify the full app scope.

changes.problem: At 320 logical width and font scale 1.5, selected font consumes label space; Arabic text wraps into fragments.
changes.fix: Shared settings rows stack picker values below labels when width divided by font scale is below 320; constrain inline value shrink and share navigation indicator rendering.

changes.problem: Compact large-text account email and membership date truncate.
changes.fix: Allow account identity text to wrap and card height to grow.

changes.problem: Every edit row exposes identical reorder and removal labels.
changes.fix: Include article title in accessibility labels; keep generic drag label available to other callers.

changes.problem: Radio controls exposed selected but no checked state in the native accessibility tree.
changes.fix: Use checked state for the shared radio card; font/theme/other settings choices inherit it.

changes.problem: Light theme settings sections contained individually rounded and shadowed rows inside the section card.
changes.fix: Section owns rounded surface/elevation; rows have zero radius and no shadow.

changes.problem: When no catalogue matches existed, a pending or failed sentence corpus still showed No texts found. Failure offered no retry.
changes.fix: Shared search empty-result composition now distinguishes idle, loading, failed/incomplete with Retry, and successful no-results. Existing partial-match notices remain.

changes.problem: Word sheet Arabic headword was painted but absent from native accessibility tree.
changes.fix: Label the shared canvas and font-loading placeholder with full Arabic text and text role. ColorCodedText and review contexts inherit the behavior.

changes.problem: Resuming a saved sentence aligned it at the full-screen viewport top, behind status bar and floating controls.
changes.fix: Resume below safe-area top plus medium toolbar diameter and small gap. FlashList v2 adds viewOffset, so use negative clearance. Existing two-frame restore regression expectation updated.

changes.problem: At compact width and 200% text, fixed-height mini-player clips the title and crowds time/queue; fixed list padding cannot clear a taller player.
changes.fix: Use minimum card height with natural content sizing and wrapping time/queue groups. Share measured player height through a transient layout subscription so scrolling screens reserve matching clearance without subscribing to audio ticks.

changes.problem: At 320 logical width and 200% text, inline custom model status squeezes Speech-to-text (Parakeet) into broken fragments; single-line status truncates longer messages.
changes.fix: Extend shared responsive settings value stacking to custom content. Allow model status text to wrap with constrained shrink.

changes.problem: At compact width and 200% text, the fixed-height Help search field clips the placeholder vertically. FAQ button names include icon glyphs and do not explicitly carry expanded state.
changes.fix: Use minimum height so search grows with text; shorten shared placeholder to Search help and use it as the stable accessible label. Label FAQ cards with their question, button role, and expanded state; mark chevron decorative.

changes.problem: Android native tab bar hidden by scrolling retains its old bounds in React Native hit-testing and consumes taps on visible content in the bottom strip.
changes.fix: Backport merged react-native-screens PR 4489 to installed 4.26.2: CustomBottomNavigationView implements ReactPointerEventsView, returning NONE while not visible and AUTO while visible. Shared native fix covers all tabs; no screen padding workaround retained.
changes.deployment: Native Android change: requires a rebuilt binary; JS-only OTA cannot apply it.

changes.problem: Support form nests two scrolling containers and adds another safe-area wrapper inside its header-owned viewport. Fields and hints have excess gaps. 0/10 looks like a maximum although ten is the minimum, and the field loses its useful accessible name once filled.
changes.fix: Use the non-scrolling scaffold around the form-owned ScrollView and plain content/meta Views; keep shared header lead-in. Stack email disclosure and an explicit remaining-character/count hint. Add stable Message label and centralize feedback helper strings, including singular character.

changes.problem: At compact 200% text, Add screenshot (optional) truncates into an incomplete label.
changes.fix: Add opt-in allowTitleWrap to the shared button; shrink label within the icon row and allow natural height. Enable for the full-width screenshot button.

changes.problem: At 320 logical width and 200% text, two-column topic cards truncate almost all topic names and descriptions.
changes.fix: Choose one or two columns from usable width and system font scale using a shared 144-point minimum column width token. Let titles/subtitles wrap inside their column. Standard layout remains two columns, including half-width odd final row.

changes.problem: At large system text, filtered article titles and bylines retain compact line caps, hiding distinguishing words and author/duration metadata.
changes.fix: Shared article row drops title/byline line caps when system font scale exceeds its default. Natural card height grows; topic, playlist and rail callers inherit readable text.

changes.problem: Malformed word links with zero, negative or fractional root IDs pass finite-number validation and claim the word was removed from practice.
changes.fix: Require a positive safe integer for the root ID; malformed IDs now use the existing invalid-link message.

changes.problem: At compact 200% text, Reviews value extends past the right edge of the word sheet.
changes.fix: Shared stat rows stack label and value at compact text widths. Rename the existing settings threshold to INLINE_VALUE_MIN_WIDTH and reuse it for both settings and word stats. Constrain value shrink.

changes.problem: Dictionary word screen uses default top/bottom safe-area padding under a native header and above native tabs, adding duplicate insets.
changes.fix: Use horizontal safe-area edges only; native header owns top clearance and content padding owns bottom clearance. Add stable dictionary-word-content scroll identifier for scoped QA.

changes.problem: At compact 200% text, the Open in your dictionary label takes the full row width and pushes its chevron off-screen.
changes.fix: Give the label the remaining flex space so it wraps alongside a visible chevron. Shared word-detail and inline revisit callers inherit the same layout.

changes.problem: Read this sentence opens the beginning of the article instead of the selected example (sentence 1853, index 13 of article 291).
changes.fix: Carry the sentence ID through the shared article route builder and example callback. Reader chooses the requested sentence before saved progress and reuses existing toolbar clearance and FlashList readiness. Explicit navigation skips the saved-resume toast; malformed sentence params are ignored. Existing callback test expectation updated.

changes.problem: At compact 200% text the recall denominator overflows and dashboard summaries truncate; habit tiles have insufficient width.
changes.fix: Allow full summaries to wrap; stack recall denominator and habit tiles using the existing shared inline-width breakpoint. MetricCard accepts a normal style override so stacked tiles use natural height rather than flex fill.

changes.problem: Four absolute axis captions overlap and their fixed container clips scaled text.
changes.fix: Use endpoint ticks when effective width is below the shared breakpoint, and size the axis to the actual scaled caption line height. All distribution bands remain in the card accessibility label and detail sheet.

changes.problem: At 200%, fixed 48-point count cells truncate 585/386/229 and single-line band hints disappear.
changes.fix: Both memory and review breakdowns share stacked label/hint and meter/count/chevron rows at the same breakpoint. Scale count width with font scale and allow full hint wrapping.

changes.problem: Large text makes the fitted chart sheet taller than the screen, without a scroll path to the final band or explanation.
changes.fix: At compact effective width use a fixed 85% detent and direct native-screen child ScrollView; standard text retains fitted SheetScreen. Named practice detent and stable sheet/dashboard IDs support shared navigation checks.

changes.problem: After closing a detail sheet near the end of Practice, downward swipes briefly hide the bar, grow the viewport, clamp the offset backward, and immediately reveal the bar again; final card stays clipped.
changes.fix: Track viewport height in native scroll events. On a viewport resize, re-anchor the direction run without changing tab-bar visibility. Genuine upward scrolling still reveals navigation. Temporary diagnostics removed.

changes.problem: Dashboard and two detail summaries duplicate metric row sizing; narrow large-text review title Per study day shrinks to tiny text.
changes.fix: Use one shared metric grid for horizontal ordinary layouts and natural-height stacked rows below the existing effective-width breakpoint. Completed before user steered away from extreme fixtures; final normal layouts verified.

changes.problem: Practice detail shells need the same fitted-versus-scrolling layout rule.
changes.fix: Extract the already implemented chart-sheet behavior into a shared shell also used by the streak sheet; use a generic named detent. Standard layouts still fit their contents.

changes.problem: At normal size forecast point controls have no names, tooltip counts differ from summary formatting, and last-day tooltip clips its +3 new suffix at the right edge. The enclosing Pressable also aggregates all point/tooltip text.
changes.fix: Give shared point controls button roles and date/value labels. Make chart background a separate sibling press target, expose tooltip as labeled text with polite live region, and use measured bubble width plus chart bounds for horizontal positioning. Group exact forecast and newly-due counts with existing formatCount.

changes.problem: Dictionary list duplicates native header and bottom safe-area insets: viewport begins at .168 with a blank strip and ends .860.
changes.fix: Reserve only horizontal safe edges, consistent with dictionary word screen. Native navigation already owns vertical clearance. Viewport now .115-.886 at standard display.

changes.problem: Native radio buttons expose no checked state and selected Strength label includes an unreadable arrow glyph.
changes.fix: Shared segmented controls expose checked and selected state, explicit labels and decorative icons. Optional active accessibility label lets dictionary speak ascending/descending through centralized strings.

changes.problem: Clearing a no-results query jumps into the middle of restored words, hiding count/filter controls even though the user never scrolled.
changes.fix: Disable FlashList v2 default item anchoring for this searchable/sortable collection. Stable dictionary-word-list ID supports scoped inspection. No imperative offset reset or new memoization.

changes.problem: Shared legal section/subsection titles only expose ordinary text semantics, making section navigation harder for screen-reader users.
changes.fix: DocHeading now passes accessibilityRole=header through ThemedText. Applies once to account/auth Terms and Privacy and account attributions. Visible layout preserved.

changes.problem: Normal-size grammar breakdowns start with Arabic and Android infers RTL paragraph direction, displaying English formula terms in reverse order: root word before conjunction/article, possessive before preposition.
changes.fix: The one shared example renderer prefixes explanation text with Unicode left-to-right mark. All four English/Arabic formulas preserve their logical sequence while Arabic headwords keep their existing rendering.

changes.problem: At normal density420/fontScale1, playlist edit-mode last11th item The Secret Migration clipped behind tab bar. Bare scroll offsets misread hide-bar viewport clamping as upward travel. After fixing this, Done remounted normal list at top without a scroll event and left tabs hidden.
changes.fix: Shared viewport reanchoring now works for full scroll events and bare offsets. DraggableFlatList reports onContainerLayout height into hook; next resized offset is treated as a position. Playlist edit-mode transitions report resting offset0, restoring tabs when new list mounts at top.

changes.problem: Git subprocesses blocked by sandbox return EPERM; wrapper swallowed every error and reported no changed files/success without validation.
changes.fix: Use direct Git argument arrays with NUL-delimited paths and propagate failures to fatal nonzero result. Correctly distinguish blocked discovery from an unchanged worktree.

changes.problem: Family words with saved destinations look identical to static family entries, hiding which rows can open.
changes.fix: Shared FamilyRow uses the existing disclosure chevron size/color for linkable rows only. Static entries keep no chevron; icon excluded from accessibility labels.

changes.problem: Normal-size short-password submission repeats the minimum-length requirement in both inline error and strength hint.
changes.fix: Suppress the strength hint while the field validation error is active; typing still shows the existing meter.

changes.problem: Playlist edit mode survived cold restart because temporary editor UI was persisted with user preferences.
changes.fix: Exclude editMode from persisted slices and reset legacy edit flags on rehydration with a fresh reducer state so reconciliation cannot restore them.
